metric: forward-dynamics video PSNR (dB) on the common 320x176 region, paired against the released checkpoint (same clip, seed, inputs)

splits.val: 90 episodes: 5% of each of tissues 1,2,4-10 (split_seed 42); 3,190 windows; every 24th window, 128 clips
splits.test: tissue 3, all 130 episodes; 4,418 windows; every 34th window, 128 clips

training.iterations: recipe default 3,000; the run was trained to 2,000, then resumed with trainer.max_iter=4000 (constant learning rate, so the schedule does not depend on max_iter)
